exclusions.name: Elena Cruz
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule; her actions do not affect the number of units received.

exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: No evidence of any other sources or destinations for blood units; only Cascade centre and St. Vincent hospital are mentioned.

exclusions.name: Weekend collections or shipments
exclusions.why_safe: Drive is only open Monday-Friday; shipments only Tuesday and Thursday. No weekend operations affect Friday noon deadline.

exclusions.name: Usage or wastage at hospital
exclusions.why_safe: The question asks for units received, not consumed. Hospital stock changes from usage are irrelevant to received units.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether the centre's stock at 4pm Tuesday (after Monday and Tuesday collections) is at least 150 units to dispatch the Tuesday shipment.
Whether the centre's stock at 4pm Thursday (after Wednesday and Thursday collections, minus Tuesday shipment) is at least 150 units to dispatch the Thursday shipment.
Number of units collected on Monday (9am-5pm) = 8 hours * 12 units/hour = 96 units, but this is based on average rate; actual may vary.
Number of units collected on Tuesday from 9am to 4pm (7 hours) = 84 units at average rate; actual may vary.
Number of units collected on Wednesday (9am-5pm) = 96 units at average rate; actual may vary.
Number of units collected on Thursday from 9am to 4pm (7 hours) = 84 units at average rate; actual may vary.
Centre stock after dispatching Tuesday shipment; depends on whether shipment occurred.
Whether the Tuesday shipment actually dispatches (depends on centre stock >= 150).
Whether the Thursday shipment actually dispatches (depends on centre stock >= 150).
Whether the Tuesday shipment is received by hospital (depends on dispatch and 3-hour travel; arrival by 7pm Tuesday, well before Friday noon).
Whether the Thursday shipment is received by hospital (depends on dispatch; arrival by 7pm Thursday, before Friday noon).
